name: Kandt House Museum

facts.label: Kandt

parts.text: A national museum on Nyarugenge area, about one kilometre from downtown, in the house associated with Richard Kandt, the first German colonial resident. It is the former Natural History Museum and covers Rwandan life before colonialism, the colonial period and the history of Kigali.
